groups.name: embed
groups.mechanism: token embedding: 64-d seeded +-1 code (greedy lowest-coherence pick) in C, plus class flags F and word-feature regs
groups.why: codes give a shared token bus that attention copies and the unembedding reads

groups.name: pos
groups.mechanism: learned position table: 8 sinusoid pairs (periods 3..23 coprime) + linear t/16
groups.why: relative-offset matching (prev token, latest boundary) by rotation of the pair code

groups.name: unembed
groups.mechanism: reads output block O against token codes
groups.why: logit_i = O . code_i

groups.name: b_unembed
groups.mechanism: END bias 30 (default when nothing writes O)
groups.why: empty rules end the turn

groups.name: layers.0.wq
groups.mechanism: attention wq:  [h0] previous-token head: query is position code rotated by -1 step, key is position code (8 sinusoid pairs, peak 8 vs 5 at neighbours); copies token code of t-1 into Vb [h1] latest sentence-boundary head (USER, BOT, . ? ! END, BOS): bnd flag + recency; copies that boundary position code into SPi [h2] latest word-separator head: copies position code of the nearest non-word-char token (<=t) into SPw
groups.why: gains chosen so the intended key beats the BOS sink / neighbours by >=6 logits

groups.name: layers.1.wq
groups.mechanism: attention wq:  [h0] previous-token carry: SPex(t)=SPi(t-1) (header of the sentence token t belongs to); Vb += 0.5*Vb(t-1) so Vb = code(t-1)+0.5code(t-2) [h1] word signature: average token code over the word-so-far (same SPw); invented names get a unique bag-of-letters signature; BOS sink gives 0 off-word
groups.why: gains chosen so the intended key beats the BOS sink / neighbours by >=6 logits
